name: fix_django_missing_security_header
description: Fixes middleware whose security header is set after an early return
prompts: SecurityHeadersMiddleware in middleware.py is supposed to add the X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header to every response, but the header assignment sits after the return statement, so it never runs and no response carries the header. Fix middleware.py so every response gets X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff while response bodies and status codes stay unchanged.

setup_files.settings.py:
SECRET_KEY = 'optarena-test-key'
DEBUG = True
ALLOWED_HOSTS = ['*']
INSTALLED_APPS = []
MIDDLEWARE = ['middleware.SecurityHeadersMiddleware']
ROOT_URLCONF = 'urls'
USE_TZ = True
setup_files.urls.py:
from django.urls import path

import views

urlpatterns = [
    path('one', views.one),
    path('two', views.two),
]

test_setup_files.test_header.py:
import os, django
os.environ.setdefault('DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE', 'settings')
django.setup()
from django.test import Client
c = Client()
for path, page in (('/one', 1), ('/two', 2)):
    r = c.get(path)
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'{path}: {r.status_code}'
    assert r.json() == {'page': page}, f'{path} body changed: {r.json()}'
    got = r.headers.get('X-Content-Type-Options')
    assert got == 'nosniff', f'{path}: X-Content-Type-Options is {got!r}, want nosniff'
print('PASS')
